findings.evidence: Lines 385-434 state every descending result on `(fun p => p ∘ Fin.rev) ⁻¹' orderedRegion T n t`; the only occurrence of `StrictAnti` in a statement is the RHS of `preimage_comp_rev_orderedRegion` (line 387). Roadmap README line 627: `Δ_n(t, T) = {t < t_n < ⋯ < t_1 < T} ⊂ ℝⁿ`; acceptance item 9 (line 1203) is the product integral over that set. `Equiv.prod_comp` confirmed in Mathlib (e.g. Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/SemiringInverse.lean:282) and `Fin.revPerm` in Mathlib/Data/Fin/Rev.lean:37.
findings.fix: Add the two corollaries stated directly on the descending set: `volume {p : Fin n → ℝ | StrictAnti p ∧ ∀ i, p i ∈ Set.Ioo t T} = ENNReal.ofReal (T - t) ^ n / n !` and, for continuous `f` and `t ≤ T`, `∫ p in {p | StrictAnti p ∧ ∀ i, p i ∈ Set.Ioo t T}, ∏ i, f (p i) = orderedProdIntegral f T n t`. Both are one line from the existing lemmas plus `Equiv.prod_comp Fin.revPerm` for `∏ i, f (q (Fin.rev i)) = ∏ i, f (q i)`.
findings.issue: The descending-region section exposes only the generic reversal transfer (`preimage_comp_rev_orderedRegion`, `volume_preimage_comp_rev_orderedRegion`, `setIntegral_preimage_comp_rev_orderedRegion`), all stated on the preimage `(· ∘ Fin.rev) ⁻¹' orderedRegion T n t`, never on the set `{p | StrictAnti p ∧ ∀ i, p i ∈ Ioo t T}` itself. A consumer holding the descending region — the roadmap's own `Δ_n(t,T) = {t < t_n < ⋯ < t_1 < T}` and the labelling the module docstring says is usual — must rewrite backwards through `preimage_comp_rev_orderedRegion` and then reindex the product by hand before the headline identification applies.

findings.evidence: Lines 368-379 (statement mentions no `orderedRegion`); lines 419-425 prove `hme` inline, and line 426 passes it to `(volume_preserving_comp_rev n).setIntegral_preimage_emb hme`.
findings.fix: Move `volume_preserving_comp_rev` next to `measurableSet_strictMono` under `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/MeasureTheory/` (the directory this PR creates for exactly this kind of upstream-shaped infrastructure), and expose the embedding fact there too as e.g. `measurableEmbedding_comp_rev`, using it in `setIntegral_preimage_comp_rev_orderedRegion` instead of the inline `have`.
findings.issue: `volume_preserving_comp_rev` mentions only upstream notions (`MeasurePreserving`, `volume`, `Fin.rev`) and its proof is independent of ordered regions, yet its canonical name is `EpsilonEridani.OrderedSimplex.volume_preserving_comp_rev` — a general Pi-measure fact filed under a simplex-specific namespace, where nobody looking for it will find it. Worse, the fact that makes it usable, `MeasurableEmbedding (fun p : Fin n → ℝ => p ∘ Fin.rev)`, is hidden as the `have hme` inside `setIntegral_preimage_comp_rev_orderedRegion`, so any consumer doing a change of variables along the reversal must reprove those six lines (`MeasurePreserving.setIntegral_preimage_emb` and `integrableOn_comp_preimage` both take it as an argument).

findings.evidence: Line 345 `theorem volume_orderedRegion (n : ℕ) (t T : ℝ)` against lines 205, 235, 240, 254, all `(T : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ)`.
findings.fix: Restate as `volume_orderedRegion (T : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ)`, matching `orderedRegion T n t` and the rest of the file.
findings.issue: `volume_orderedRegion (n : ℕ) (t T : ℝ)` takes its endpoints in the order `t, T`, the reverse of `orderedRegion T n t` and of every other region lemma in the file (`orderedRegion_zero (T t)`, `measurableSet_orderedRegion (T n t)`, `orderedRegion_subset_Icc (T n t)`, `integrableOn_orderedRegion_prod (hf T n t)`). Both endpoints are `ℝ`, so `volume_orderedRegion n T t` typechecks and silently yields the wrong statement.

findings.evidence: Mathlib marks the analogous closed forms simp: `Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Measure/Lebesgue/Basic.lean:85 @[simp] theorem volume_Icc`, `:95 @[simp] theorem volume_Ioo`, `:131 @[simp] theorem volume_ball`. Neither line 345 nor line 404 here has an attribute.
findings.issue: `volume_orderedRegion` is an unconditional closed-form volume computation whose RHS is strictly simpler than its LHS, but carries no `@[simp]`, so `simp` cannot evaluate region volumes; the same holds for `volume_preimage_comp_rev_orderedRegion` (line 404), which reduces a preimage volume to the region's.

summary: The ascending-region API is complete and well-characterized, but the descending half stops at a generic change-of-variables and never delivers the volume/product-integral statements on the set it names, a general measure-preserving fact is exported under the OrderedSimplex namespace while its indispensable MeasurableEmbedding companion is buried in a proof, and volume_orderedRegion both reverses the file's (T, n, t) argument order and lacks @[simp].
